# 黑粉盒子 HyphenBox · Free AI API Radar, Model Verification & Unified Interface

**Find a suitable free AI API, test it with your own key, then connect it to common AI coding tools.**

黑粉盒子 (HyphenBox) is a desktop AI API management tool developed by 黑粉科技. It combines free resource discovery, a local key vault, model verification, local unified routing, and standalone image/video tools. DeepSeek Harness supports one-click integration for chat and free media tools; other compatible clients keep their configuration guides. Resource conditions come with official evidence and verification dates. Whether a model is usable depends on your own account and real requests.

The software is free to download and does not require a 黑粉盒子 account. Platform keys must be applied for separately, and some platforms require international network access. Free quotas, regions, and account conditions are determined by each platform.

## Recent Additions and Improvements (Latest 5)

- **1.0.7** · Image and video history supports removing individual entries, batch-clearing finished items, and undo. The default shows the latest six entries, and they can still be restored after reopening.
- **1.0.7** · Added reusable platform protocol configuration. Platforms, saved keys, models, and parameters are unified, so new models under the same protocol no longer require dedicated code.
- **1.0.7** · Distinguishes periodic quotas, time-limited zero pricing, community queues, and new-user trials. Account conditions are confirmed first, and paid or undeclared credentials are not allowed through.
- **1.0.7** · Submissions, queries, failure responses, and downloads are logged separately. Recovery only handles the original task, and clearing history still retains files and idempotency keys.
- **1.0.7** · The 8 existing native media tools in Harness read the same channels and parameters. Images and videos continue to use the unified Step 3 entry point.

## ▶ Demo

**Demos of key saving, client configuration, and MCP from earlier versions. The YouTube video is the full introduction. The videos do not show the new Harness integration.**

Free lists answer “where do I find it,” but they cannot tell you “can my key be used right now.” 黑粉盒子 separates resource discovery from local calls: first check the official conditions, then verify with your own account, and finally connect the client.

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

# NarraFork

Simplified Chinese · [English](https://github.com/NarraFork/NarraFork/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md)

**Efficient Durable Harness for multi-person collaboration, multi-model collaboration, and multi-device handoff**

NarraFork is a self-hosted AI programming collaboration workbench. Deployed on your own computer or server, you (and your team) organize AI sessions, operate code and terminals, and manage agents' context and permissions in the browser.

[Quick Start](#快速开始) · [Core Capabilities](#核心能力) · [Contributing](#参与开发) · [Documentation](#文档) · [License](#许可证)

## Core Capabilities

| Capability | What you can do |
| --- | --- |
| Multi-session workspace | [Organize session panels](#组织会话面板), save and restore layouts, switch between multiple tasks |
| Multi-agent collaboration | Delegate exploration, implementation, and review tasks, [send messages to and take over discussions with sub-agents directly](#向子-agent-发送消息与接手讨论) |
| Context management | [Low-cost forking](#低成本分叉), [reversible and editable compression](#可逆可编辑的压缩), giving you unprecedented control over context |
| Development tools | Read and edit files, search code, run commands, use [interactive terminals](#交互式终端) and Git workflows |
| Permissions and approvals | Configure access rules for directories and commands, approve operations that require authorization |
| Model access | Configure different model providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, and other access protocols |
| Extensions and automation | Use Skills, routines, and MCP tools to organize repetitive work into reusable workflows |
| Team knowledge | Share projects, in-site messages, and knowledge bases, controlling knowledge access through levels and tags |
| Cross-device work | Access through a browser, [connect remote execution devices](#连接远程执行设备), [follow up on tasks on your phone](#在手机上跟进任务) |

Currently supports Simplified Chinese and English. The architecture is prepared for more languages, and contributions of your translations are welcome.

## Feature Details

### Low-Cost Forking

NarraFork does not store a separate JSONL file for each session. Instead, it stores messages in a database. When forking, only the necessary references are copied, so shared context data occupies space only once and is not repeatedly copied with each fork.

### Reversible and Editable Compression

Each compression leaves a “compression marker” in the conversation. The conversation before the marker remains visible to humans, but for the model it has been replaced by the compression result. Through the marker, you can view and edit the summary, or revert the compression and restore the corresponding historical context. Compression is no longer an invisible, unchangeable one-time operation.

### Interactive Terminal

No need to repeatedly fill in environment variables for every command, or prepend a long `ssh` or `sshpass` prefix. After logging in to a remote machine and setting up environment variables in the interactive terminal, the Agent…

# Murge

**Another [Mihomo](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo) GUI**

Murge is a modern Mihomo graphical client built on Electron + Vue 3, focused on providing a clean and efficient proxy management experience.

## Recent Project Status and Feedback

Murge currently meets my personal daily needs, and I will keep improving it based on real-world issues and everyone's feedback. If you find a bug or want a new feature, feel free to submit an [Issues](https://github.com/RoaycL/Murge/issues). Codex and Claude will look into it together right away to investigate problems, evaluate requirements, and move development forward.

When reporting a bug, please include the app version, reproduction steps, and relevant logs or screenshots if possible. When proposing a new feature, please also describe the use case and expected behavior so we can understand and handle it more quickly.

You're welcome to join the [Telegram group](https://t.me/murgeapp) to share your experience, exchange configurations, and discuss new features. For bugs and feature requests, please submit them to Issues as well to make tracking progress easier.

## Interface Preview

### Activity

View network latency, real-time upload and download rates, active connections, and per-app traffic.

### Overview

Centrally manage the system proxy, TUN mode, sniffing override, and DNS override.

### Connections

View active and closed connections, search by process, domain, IP, or policy, and inspect connection paths.

### Processes

View traffic, connection count, and program path for each app.

### Policies

Switch the outbound mode and view policy groups and the currently selected node.

### Node Selection

Expand policy groups, view node latency, and switch nodes.

## Features

- **Ready to use out of the box** — no complex configuration needed; start and use
- **TUN mode** — system-level virtual network adapter; global proxying without manually configuring the system proxy
- **Subscription management** — supports multiple subscription configs, with automatic updates and switching
- **Policy groups** — visual node management with manual selection, automatic speed testing, and failover
- **Rule engine** — full support for Mihomo rule sets, with real-time rule hit statistics
- **System proxy** — one-click takeover and restore of the system proxy, intelligently remembering the original state
- **Dark theme** — supports light and dark themes, adapting to the system appearance
- **Auto update** — automatically checks for updates within the app, with support for GitHub mirror acceleration
- **Local diagnostic report** — export startup time, task and service status, and port ownership from the Logs page; raw logs and subscription keys are not included

# Hongguo Short Drama TV

Standalone Android TV client project, implemented as an Android shell with a Go core.

The current version includes a runnable Go local service, an Android TV shell, a Mac-style recommendation page, Hongguo category and detail APIs, and a built-in APK playback pipeline. It is built with GitHub Actions.

## Project Direction

- Keep the left sidebar and right content area of the Mac version; the recommendation page centers on the video feed.
- Redesign remote-control focus, panel fallback, and playback state restoration for TV.
- The Android shell, Go compilation, and packaging workflow reference `aston314/vidsrc-local-proxy`; the playback protocol reuses the verified signing and CENC decryption implementation.
- The APK is compiled on GitHub Actions for `arm64-v8a`, `armeabi-v7a`, and `x86_64`.

## Feature Scope

Recommendations, drama search, categories, rankings, new dramas, details, episode selection, continuous playback, same-series, next season, history, favorites, likes, reservations, account login, comments, danmaku, plus playback controls and download capabilities.

The scope lists goals and does not mean the above features are already implemented. Interfaces without source code and internal algorithms must be verified item by item, especially accounts, seasons, danmaku, and downloads.

# MMRemover

**Minecraft Malware Remover** — a program for automatically removing viruses from Minecraft plugins.

**Malware domains to ban at the hosting provider:** the current list is at [b0b0b0.dev/vb.json](https://b0b0b0.dev/vb.json) (JSON, can be parsed automatically). Some of the domains are already dead, but blocking them at DNS is still worthwhile.

## Removes

- Hostflow
- Артёмка
- bStats.jar
- PluginMetrics.jar
- aph
- ChbkHack
- ruBstatsHack (`ru/bstats`, `me/bstats` + `bstats.xyz`)
- **SystemMetrics** (`panel.bstats.co`)
- **KtoDropper** (`lib/metrics/Boot`, `META-INF/m.bin`, `kto.ultimatebox.fun`)
- **Backdoor in the PAPI extension**: `register()` launches its own class with a fake console, network, and obfuscation. It is detected by behavior, not by class names

The JAR embeds a fake "bStats": the `SystemMetrics` method downloads a payload from **`panel.bstats.co`** (this is **not** the real bStats) and calls `onEnableInj`. MMRemover finds and removes it.

But there is a nuance worth knowing in advance.

## ⚠️ Notes

**Please review the following before using this API.**

- **This is unofficial.** It has no affiliation with the BOATRACE official website or related organizations.
- **Not real-time.** Because data is updated periodically at about 10-minute intervals via GitHub Actions, there may be a delay of roughly 10 to 20 minutes before the latest information is reflected.
- **Accuracy and completeness are not guaranteed.** Due to collection and conversion processes, missing or incorrect data may be included.
- **If you need official information, always check the BOATRACE official website.**
- **Use at your own risk.**

---

## 📝 Overview

This API provides access to boatrace (motorboat racing) data. The data is published on GitHub Pages and provided in JSON format.

| Item | Details |
|---|---|
| Supported venues | All 24 venues nationwide (one day's data includes information for all venues) |
| Available data | Racecards, pre-race information, results |

---

## 🌐 Endpoint

Supported period: **From January 1, 2026 onward**

```bash
https://boatraceopenapi.github.io/api/v1/YYYY/YYYYMMDD.json
```

- `YYYY` → year
- `YYYYMMDD` → year, month, and day
- Dates are based on Japan Standard Time (JST / UTC+9)

> If you specify a date with no data (such as a date outside the supported period or a future date), GitHub Pages returns HTTP 404 as per its specification.

For details on the JSON response structure and each field, see the schema documentation.

→ [docs/v1/schema.md](https://github.com/boatraceopenapi/api/blob/HEAD/docs/v1/schema.md)

# marble XNU — iOS 16 kernel running on Redmi Note 12 Turbo

> **Required reading for the audio/SMMU work:** [`docs/smmu-dead-ends.md`](https://github.com/jebbranch/ios-port-marble/blob/HEAD/docs/smmu-dead-ends.md) — SMMU approaches that have already been disproven, the correct register map, and the discipline of "stop using DATA_BUFFER as a probe."

> Device-specific handoff notes and failure checklists are maintained only locally and are not part of this repository.

This project runs Apple's open-source **XNU 8796.141.3** (the kernel contemporary with iOS 16) on the **Redmi Note 12 Turbo (marble / SM7475 / Snapdragon 7+ Gen 2)**.
It launches via **shim + `fastboot boot`, running purely from RAM**: it does not flash boot, does not write userdata, and does not modify GPT. When the test ends, the kernel resets itself and the phone returns to TWRP/Android.

> Research project, for learning and experimentation only. Apple firmware and userspace images are not distributed. Do not treat this as a daily-use phone system.

# Learn Ukrainian

**Мова -- душа народу** | Language is the soul of a nation

A free, open-source Ukrainian language course from A1 to C2, based on the **Ukrainian State Standard 2024** and aligned with **CEFR**.

**[Start Learning](https://learn-ukrainian.github.io)**

---

## What is this?

A comprehensive Ukrainian language curriculum with 1,778 modules across 22 tracks:

- **6 core CEFR levels** (A1 -- C2) covering grammar, vocabulary, and communication
- **16 specialization tracks** -- history, biographies, literature, professional Ukrainian, folk culture, Old East Slavic, and Ruthenian
- **Theory-first approach** -- understand grammar deeply, not just memorize phrases
- **Interactive exercises** -- quizzes, matching, fill-in-the-blank, error correction
- **Cultural context** -- decolonization perspective, authentic Ukrainian sources
- **100% free** -- no ads, no subscriptions, no paywalls

molimao/iota.description: Open-source, five-language mining dashboard for IOTA Train at Home, PRL, BNT, XMR, ERG, ZEPH and more: saved addresses, worker status, available rewards and optional Mac agent controls.
molimao/iota.body:
# IOTA Watch

An open-source, five-language, multi-project monitoring dashboard centered on **IOTA Train at Home**. It supports IOTA, XID / MMM, Quantus, fly.ai, Nosana, Gonka, Akash, io.net, Vast.ai and Golem; each project's inputs, cycles, and data coverage are described separately.

**[Official site](https://iotahome.site) · [My Devices](https://iotahome.site/zh/devices) · [IOTA Lookup](https://iotahome.site/zh/app) · [Network Status](https://iotahome.site/zh/network) · [Blog](https://iotahome.site/zh/blog) · [English](https://iotahome.site/en)**

IOTA Watch is an independent MIT-licensed monitor in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean and Japanese. IOTA Train at Home (Macrocosmos / Bittensor SN9) is the core project, with ten project pages covering training, mining and compute. Tool pages query records; separate tutorials explain identifiers, fields and troubleshooting. Public projects use public identifiers; io.net and Vast.ai require account connections with read credentials. Those two integrations have mocked validation; real-account validation remains pending.

The screenshot shows miner distribution and network capacity; the figures are official data as of when the screenshot was taken.

## Features

- **Multi-device monitoring**: add, name, and view devices by public Miner ID, filtering by contributing, waiting for tasks, needs checking, and pending confirmation.
- **Earnings records**: today, cumulative, paid, pending payment, frozen, and minimum payment amounts; also shows USD valuations with source and timestamp.
- **Training history**: view training tokens, throughput, and cumulative tokens by day, week, or month; missing data is left as gaps.
- **Network visualization**: regional distribution donut chart, miner count rankings, slot occupancy, task progress, and tier overview.

ohmyangboy/lives.body:
# Lives

> **Lives in lives** —— On a Mac, turn multiple moments from a video into a true Live Photo.

[English](https://github.com/ohmyangboy/lives/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md) · [Simplified Chinese](https://github.com/ohmyangboy/lives/blob/HEAD/README.md) · [Product website](https://lives.1leaf.cc/) · [GitHub Pages mirror](https://ohmyangboy.github.io/lives/) · [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ohmyangboy/lives/releases) · [Mobile website](https://ohmyangboy.github.io/lives-mobile-website/)

---

## Product overview

Lives is a tool built specifically for Live Photo collages, offering a native macOS desktop app and iOS mobile support:

- **macOS version (Lives Mac)**: **Fully open source and free**. A native macOS tool for converting videos into iPhone Live Photos. Freely clip segments from multiple MOV/MP4/M4V sources, adjust the Live duration from 1–15 seconds, control precisely with keyframes, sync to Apple Photos in one click, with 100% local processing throughout.
- **iOS version (Lives Mobile)**: **Basic features are all free; only Pro features are available as a one-time purchase (it would be even better if a Pro subscription plan could be supported!)**. A video-to-Live collage tool for iOS: any video can be combined in the way you want to capture the moments of your life. Now officially available on the App Store.

> The interface was recorded from the real Lives runtime environment, using only public test material; it contains no user videos or personal information.

---

## Core principles

- 🔒 **100% local processing**: original files are decoded locally with no upload to the cloud, and materials always stay on your machine; no accounts, no cloud media library.
- ⏱️ **Freely adjustable 1–15 seconds**: each cell has an independently clipped segment; supports keyframe control via the film strip and viewer, and playback gently returns to the keyframe when it ends.
- 📐 **8 × 5 free combinations**: 8 preset layouts (top/bottom, left/right, triptych, large-and-small frames, etc.) × 5 scene ratios (9:16, 3:4, 1:1, 4:3, 16:9).
- 📷 **A true Live Photo**: generates a JPEG and MOV with paired metadata, written to the photo library as a native Live Photo asset, preserving the full live motion effect through iCloud Photos.

---

osfree-project/osfree.body:
## osFree, Open Source OS/2 Clone

osFree(OS/3): The reincarnation of OS/2.



English:

English:

# Getting the source code

osFree sources consist of the main Git repository and several submodules.
The main git repo is osfree, and submodules are:

FamilyAPI, MacroLib, fat32, jfs, os3 and others.

Hence, you need to clone the main osfree repo first, and then
pull the submodules:

> git clone https://github.com/osfree-project/osfree.git

> git submodule update --init --recursive --remote

Update from repositories:

> git pull

> git submodule update --init --recursive --remote

# osFree build system

First, start %root%\\conf\\scripts\\_setup.{cmd|sh|bat}, to pull the build dependencies.
After finishing the script work, you can start build with _wcc.{sh|cmd}.

Under Windows host you can just execute _wcc.cmd from repository root. _setup.cmd will be executed automatically.

Note that _wcc.cmd autodetects OS (OS/2, win32 or win64).

Generally, we use .bat scripts specific for windows, .cmd specific to OS/2, and
.sh specific to UNIX/Linux.

xinxing1708/DSH-Codex-Style.body:
# DSH Codex Style

A Codex desktop-style dark theme for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**.

Current version **0.2.1**, adapted for **Windows DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 / rc.3 / rc.4 / rc.5**.

## Features

This version additionally adapts to DSH 0.2.1-rc.4. Starting from 0.2.0, a DSH self-update button was added and rc.5 is supported. The installer can find DSH installed in other directories, and the Codex-style work guidelines now use the new prompt. The default switch for each optional submodule is unchanged, and upgrades keep existing selections.

- **Themed interface (main module)**: Codex-style navigation, a collapsible sidebar, and an input area. Supports project/session search and management, model and permission selection, a thinking-intensity slider with a MAX animation, session running/completed notifications, and this plugin's update check, automatic download, download progress, and confirmed installation. When a new DSH version is available, a blue update button appears above the gear icon in the lower-left corner. Hovering over it shows download progress. Downloading and installing are still performed by DSH. The native DSH editor, attachments, tool calls, and approval flow are preserved.

- **Codex-style work guidelines (optional submodule, off by default)**: Adds an extra work-guidelines prompt that guides the model to clarify task boundaries, reduce unnecessary changes, separate review from execution, keep communicating in Chinese, and deliver based on evidence. The user's existing `AGENTS.md` remains in effect and is not replaced or rewritten. The actual effect depends on the model following it.

  The switch takes effect immediately for subsequent model requests. If DSH prompts for a restart, restart before use. Turning it off does not withdraw prompts already sent to the model, nor roll back content already produced in the same conversation. Requests in progress are not affected, and starting a new conversation after switching is recommended.

- **Codex body effects (optional submodule, on by default)**: Shows a "processed" duration and divider at the top of each turn, and adds an operation shimmer, step expand animations, and pencil, terminal, and image icons. The expand arrow appears on hover. Thinking content has no leading icon, live thinking content is hidden, and it can still be expanded after completion. Requires the main module to be enabled. When turned off, DSH's original body presentation is restored.

- **Codex top bar redraw (optional submodule, on by default)**: The session top bar uses a layout with the title and right-side tools on top, and mode/agent/background tasks and view switching below. "Chat / Trace" uses a white sliding pill, and additional views use a four-square icon. This is independent of the body effects and requires the main module to be enabled. When turned off, DSH's native top bar layout and view styles are restored.

- **Page back/forward (optional submodule, on by default)**: Adds back and forward buttons in the upper-left corner of the window, switching between recently opened sessions and global panels based on in-memory history for the current run. Supports Ctrl+[ / Ctrl+]. This is not a native DSH feature: history exists only in memory for the current run and is cleared on restart. It does not restore settings dialogs, in-page state, or scroll position. It is independent of the top bar redraw and body effects, and requires the main module to be enabled. When turned off, the buttons and shortcuts are removed, and the original sidebar toggle button returns to its original position.
